state.seed_assertion: When a technician identifies a defect but does not immediately repair it, the finding should be recorded as an open next action rather than written as a resolved maintenance event.

sentences.1: Making simultaneous changes to multiple parts prevents determining which action resolved the fault.
sentences.2: Next are unwanted interactions, be they ground loops or interactions of multiple processors finding weaknesses in the hardware or software interfaces.
sentences.3: Maintenance logs should include recurring faults in analysis to identify when a repair has not resolved the underlying issue.
